summary: Phases 01 and 02 fully match their plan sections: the Claude and Codex catalog reorders, new entries, deprecations, equivalence anchors and the deprecated-spoke guard were independently confirmed against src/domain/routing/defaults.ts and match the plan exactly. Phase 03 delivered its code-level objective (DEFAULT_CODE_REVIEW_MODEL and adjustPlan's DEFAULT_MODEL are both claude-opus-5-5/high, confirmed in source) but did not deliver the planning-skill guidance subsection in .claude/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md or the dependent docs/model-catalog.md section 4/6 updates; this gap is self-disclosed and reasoned in the phase-03 handoff (a stuck Edit-tool permission prompt, and a deliberate decision to defer the two dependent doc edits together rather than commit an inconsistent state), but it leaves part of the plan's stated objective unmet and needs a human follow-up pass before the run is considered closed.
